_doc: Wards (src/wards.py) and monster gates (src/attack_gates.py), MONSTERS AND MAGIC 2026-11-19. A ward is a hero status: 'family' wards keep one family off (holds: melee = no blow, bite, touch, grapple, sting or trample from it; riders = its blows carry none of the listed riders; sight = it cannot notice the hero; damage = its damage times mult). 'breaks': creature = striking one of the family ends the ward against that one; all = striking any one ends it for all; never. A named foe (boss, mini-boss, seal demon) is too strong for a melee ward: its first blow lands at half and the ward breaks against it; a sight ward does not fool it; a damage ward holds against it too. The other wards are the hero's own: missile_ward (every missile fails), stayed_spear (missiles from foes he can see fail), veiled (no foe farther than veil_reach sees him or shoots him), all_round_ward (a pack round him gains nothing), sanctuary (ordinary foes hold off until he strikes; one he hurt in the last sanctuary_memory turns does not), styx_dipped (no blow, bite or claw wounds him; an unseen one lands at half).

ward_lemuria.name: Lemuria Ward
ward_lemuria.desc: The restless dead cannot strike you up close until you strike one
ward_lemuria.held: {The} reaches for you, then turns aside: the shades took the beans.
ward_lemuria.broken: You struck {the}: the beans no longer buy you off {him}.
ward_lemuria.named: {The} is too strong for the old rite: the blow lands half spent, and the beans buy nothing more from {him}.
ward_lemuria.expire: The beans are spent. The dead may come at you again.

ward_daniel.name: Daniel's Ward
ward_daniel.desc: Great beasts cannot bite or claw you until you strike one
ward_daniel.held: {The} snaps at you, and {his} jaws will not close.
ward_daniel.broken: You struck {the}: {his} jaws are free of the angel's hand.
ward_daniel.named: {The} is too great for the angel's hand: the blow lands half spent, and {his} jaws are free.
ward_daniel.expire: The lions' mouths are open again.

ward_psylli.name: Psylli Ward
ward_psylli.desc: A serpent's bite cannot poison you, and its coils cannot hold you
ward_psylli.rider: {The}'s bite is only a bite to you: the Psylli's charm keeps its {noun} out.
ward_psylli.expire: The Psylli's charm fades. A serpent's bite is a serpent's bite again.

ward_hoichi.name: Heart Sutra
ward_hoichi.desc: Ghosts cannot see you; strike one and they all find you
ward_hoichi.broken_all: You struck {the}, and every ghost here finds you at once: the sutra missed your ears.
ward_hoichi.expire: The sutra fades from your skin. The ghosts can see you again.

ward_martha.name: Martha's Hymn
ward_martha.desc: Dragons hurt you half as much, breath and bite alike
ward_martha.damage: Saint Martha's hymn takes the heat out of {the}.
ward_martha.expire: Saint Martha's hymn is sung out.

ward_udug_hul.name: Udug Hul
ward_udug_hul.desc: Demons cannot strike you up close, and their curses and terrors do not take hold, until you strike one
ward_udug_hul.held: {The} cannot lay a hand on you: the old names bind {him}.
ward_udug_hul.rider: {The}'s {noun} slides off you: the old names bind {him}.
ward_udug_hul.broken: You struck {the}: the old names no longer bind {him}.
ward_udug_hul.named: {The} knows older names than these: the blow lands half spent, and the binding breaks for {him}.
ward_udug_hul.expire: The words of the tablet fall silent.

ward_deliver_us.name: Delivered
ward_deliver_us.desc: Demons, ghosts, vampires and the walking dead cannot strike you up close until you strike them
ward_deliver_us.held: {The} cannot cross the ring of your prayer.
ward_deliver_us.broken: You struck {the}: your prayer no longer keeps {him} off.
ward_deliver_us.named: {The} is mighty enough to strike through the prayer: the blow lands half spent, and the ring breaks for {him}.
ward_deliver_us.expire: The ring of your prayer fades.

missile_ward: No arrow, stone or spear reaches you
stayed_spear: Missiles from foes you can see drop short
The galdr dies away. Missiles fly true at you again.
veiled: Foes more than 2 steps away cannot see you
all_round_ward: A pack round you gains nothing by it
The breastplate's guard on every side lifts.
sanctuary: Ordinary foes will not strike you until you strike
styx_dipped: No blow, bite or claw can wound you; an unseen blow finds the heel
The Styx dries from your skin. You can be wounded again.
free_action: Nothing can grab, pin or drag you
The loosing-song fades. A grip could hold you again.
wakeful: Nothing can put you to sleep
The coffee wears off. You could sleep again.
clear_sight: No vision or false sight can take hold of you
Your mind is your own, and open again to tricks.

lines.missile_ward: {The}'s {attack} turns aside before it reaches you.
lines.stayed_spear: {The}'s {attack} stops in the air and drops at your feet.
lines.veiled: {The} cannot see you in the mist: {his} {attack} goes wide.
lines.sanctuary: {The} will not strike you: you are in sanctuary.
lines.styx_heel: {The} finds the heel the Styx never touched.
lines.pull_loosed: {The} pulls at you, but nothing can hold you.

gates._doc: Monster gates (src/attack_gates.py): what a monster cannot use now. silenced: no voice attack, no magic cast from range, no summoning, no healing. unstrung: no missile, breath or gaze (its opener too); it has to come to the hero. babbled: its pack or war band forgets how to fight together. A named foe holds silenced or unstrung named_turns at most, and shakes off the next for named_grace turns after.

lines.silenced: {The}'s mouth works, and no sound comes out.
lines.silenced_cast: {The} shapes a spell with {his} lips, and no word comes.
lines.unstrung: {The} reaches for {his} {attack}, and it will not answer {him}.
lines.unstrung_gaze: {The} turns {his} eyes on you, and there is no power in them.
